checkResults.description: No bare numeric line-height — use a --shelf-font-lineheight-* token
No raw line-height values — must use tokens
CSS must be wrapped in @layer components

VFT-02.prompt_excerpt: Write a ArticlePreview component and its CSS. It shows a title with tight line-height (~1.3) and a body excerpt with normal line-height (~1.5). Use @layer components for the CSS. Use tokens for all styling (assume --shelf-* tokens exist for font properties including line-height). Include the CSS file.
VFT-02.output:
Here's the CSS file at `src/components/ArticlePreview/ArticlePreview.css`.

Key decisions:
- `@layer components` wraps all rules per the constraint
- `.article-preview-title` uses `--shelf-lineHeight-tight` (~1.3) and `.article-preview-excerpt` uses `--shelf-lineHeight-normal` (~1.5)
- All values reference `--shelf-*` tokens — component-tier color aliases (`--shelf-article-preview-fgColor-*`, `--shelf-article-preview-bgColor-*`) and shared scale tokens for font size, weight, and line-height
- No raw values, no margin, kebab-case selectors throughout
